mentions.h: Mark Miles wins AAA 5k title but Bels lose the team race on count back

photos.c: Above: The start of the inaugural AAA 5 km Road Championship, held in conjunction with the Horwich Carnival race.  From left to right Peter Riley (107 Leigh H), Rob Whalley (90 Bristol & West AC), Andi Jones (51 Salford), David Anderson (88 Belgrave H) with Mark Miles on his left, behind Ian Mitchell (114 Tipton), the eventual winner Wilf Taragon (85 Birchfield), Mark Tucker (126 Australia), Birhan Dagne (217 Belgrave H) is on the right.  Mark Miles placed second with the fastest time run by a Briton in Britain this year – 13:58 – and took the AAA Championship.
